ABOUT THE INSTITUTE
650 acres, now has 24 departments in four colleges on the
campus with a network of eleven constituent colleges, and
471 affiliated colleges. KU College of Engineering &
Technology is established in the year 2009 with four
programmes viz., B.Tech (CSE ECE, EEE, Mech), later in
2012, B.Tech (IT and Civil) and two M.tech (D.C and C.S.E)
Programmes were introduced. It is one of the fast-growing
technical institutions for developing excellence in technical
education.

In the era of globalization soft skills and communication

organization or institution. The objectives of any
organization can be attained only through proper verbal
and non-verbal communication. So, it is considered to be
the dire need of the hour to focus on soft skills and
communication. In the present COVID-19 pandemic
situation it is essential to formulate suitable programs to
meet the challenges of digital initiatives, which was
emphasized in the recent New Education Policy (NEP) of
Government of India. At the professional front also, it is
